curriculum.subject: Mathematical Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: identify the sh.50 Kenyan currency note

mission.title: identify the sh.50 Kenyan currency note

interactions.prompt: Tap the Kenyan money that says Sh 50.
interactions.feedback: Yes! This is the Sh 50 Kenyan note.
interactions.retryHint: Look for the paper note with 50 on it.

interactions.prompt: A Sh 50 note is a paper note, not a round coin. Tap it.
interactions.feedback: Good looking! The Sh 50 money is a note.
interactions.retryHint: Choose the flat paper note with 50 written on it.

interactions.prompt: Match the Sh 50 note to its value.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap the note, then tap Sh 50.
interactions.feedback: Well done! The note is worth fifty shillings.
interactions.retryHint: The number 50 tells the value of this note.

interactions.prompt: Which one is the Sh 50 Kenyan note?
interactions.feedback: Correct! You found the Sh 50 note.
interactions.retryHint: Find the paper note marked 50, not a round coin.

interactions.prompt: At the classroom shop, put the Sh 50 note in the note tray.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap each money piece, then tap its tray.
interactions.feedback: Great sorting! You put the Sh 50 note in the right tray.
interactions.retryHint: Only the paper note with 50 belongs in the Sh 50 note tray.

interactions.prompt: Show what you know. Tap the Kenyan note worth fifty shillings.
interactions.feedback: Excellent! You can identify the Sh 50 Kenyan note.
interactions.retryHint: Look for the paper note that says 50.
